# International Journal of Innovative Science and Research Technology (IJISRT)

> > IJISRT is a peer-reviewed academic journal publishing multidisciplinary research across engineering, environmental science, healthcare, technology, and social sciences.

The International Journal of Innovative Science and Research Technology (IJISRT) serves as a platform for researchers worldwide to publish original studies spanning diverse fields including materials science, environmental engineering, medical education, information technology, and social research. The journal hosts regular issues and special conferences such as ICMST-2025, RISEM-2025, and MMK:ACE series.

## Key Topics

- IJISRT - International Journal of Innovative Science and Research Technology
- Academic journal publishing and peer review
- Research papers and scientific publications
- ICMST-2025 conference proceedings
- RISEM-2025 research symposium
- MMK:ACE conference series (2019-2023)
- Environmental science and sustainability
- Materials engineering and concrete technology
- Healthcare and medical education research
- Information technology and digital systems
- Social sciences and behavioral studies
- Renewable energy technologies
- GGBFS and metakaolin in construction

## Engineering and Materials Science Research

- [Durability and strength aspects of cement concrete using ggbfs and metakolin](https://www.ijisrt.com/durability-and-strength-aspects-of-cement-concrete-using-ggbfs-and-metakolin): Concrete durability study using GGBFS and metakaolin additives
- [The effect of norust 720 and ch1377a inhibitors on n80 steel corroded by bacterial corrosion](https://www.ijisrt.com/the-effect-of-norust-720-and-ch1377a-inhibitors-on-n80-steel-corroded-by-bacterial-corrosion): Corrosion inhibitor effectiveness on N80 steel bacterial corrosion
- [Hydro geochemical and geoelectrical investigation of mubi and its environs in adamawa state northeastern nigeria](https://www.ijisrt.com/hydro-geochemical-and-geoelectrical-investigation-of-mubi-and-its-environs-in-adamawa-state-northeastern-nigeria): Hydrogeochemical study of Mubi area in Adamawa State, Nigeria

## Environmental Science and Sustainability

- [Environmental risk assessment health hazards and aspect of eco labeling of cement dust pollution](https://www.ijisrt.com/environmental-risk-assessment-health-hazards-and-aspect-of-eco-labeling-of-cement-dust-pollution): Environmental risk and health hazards of cement dust pollution assessment
- [Device turns air pollution into ink](https://www.ijisrt.com/device-turns-air-pollution-into-ink): Innovative device converting air pollution into usable ink
- [How can the waste problem in india be solved by prompting changes in behavioural patterns of individuals and society](https://www.ijisrt.com/how-can-the-waste-problem-in-india-be-solved-by-prompting-changes-in-behavioural-patterns-of-individuals-and-society): Behavioral change approach to solving India's waste management problem
- [Harnessing of wave energy as renewable energy an overview](https://www.ijisrt.com/harnessing-of-wave-energy-as-renewable-energy-an-overview): Overview of wave energy harvesting as renewable energy source

## Healthcare and Medical Education

- [Relationship between time management and stress among under graduate nursing students](https://www.ijisrt.com/relationship-between-time-management-and-stress-among-under-graduate-nursing-students): Study on time management and stress correlation in nursing students
- [Knowledge and awareness among dental students about choice of complete denture occlusion in edentulous patient](https://www.ijisrt.com/knowledge-and-awareness-among-dental-students-about-choice-of-complete-denture-occlusion-in-edentulous-patient): Dental students' knowledge on complete denture occlusion choices
- [Quantification and antimicrobial activity of phytochemicals from combretum ovalifolium](https://www.ijisrt.com/quantification-and-antimicrobial-activity-of-phytochemicals-from-combretum-ovalifolium): Antimicrobial phytochemical analysis of Combretum ovalifolium plant
- [Quality of responsiveness of body organs kayfit infl with respect to determination of human temperament](https://www.ijisrt.com/quality-of-responsiveness-of-body-organs-kayfit-infl-with-respect-to-determination-of-human-temperament): Body organ responsiveness and human temperament determination study

## Social Sciences and Education Research

- [A study on knowledge and perception regarding learning disabilities in children among primary school teachers in thiruvallur district](https://www.ijisrt.com/a-study-on-knowledge-and-perception-regarding-learning-disabilities-in-children-among-primary-school-teachers-in-thiruvallur-district): Teachers' perception of learning disabilities in Thiruvallur district
- [Effective management skills of heads in private and public schools a study](https://www.ijisrt.com/effective-management-skills-of-heads-in-private-and-public-schools-a-study): Comparative study of school leadership in private and public schools
- [Influence of social media marketing communications among young consumers](https://www.ijisrt.com/influence-of-social-media-marketing-communications-among-young-consumers): Social media marketing influence on young consumer behavior

## Information Technology and Digital Systems

- [Quality analysis of service trust and perception of information technology on satisfaction and loyalty of internet banking customers using government banks in makassar city](https://www.ijisrt.com/quality-analysis-of-service-trust-and-perception-of-information-technology-on-satisfaction-and-loyalty-of-internet-banking-customers-using-government-banks-in-makassar-city): Internet banking customer satisfaction analysis in Makassar government banks
